list.name: value
list.label: Decoded value
list.description: Field of the decoded EEP, e.g. temperature, humidity, illumination, meter_reading

panels.title: $value over time
panels.description: Every decoded EEP field is written as its own influx field. Switch the 'Decoded value' variable to humidity, illumination, meter_reading, wind_speed, ...

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "${value}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.device_name, set: ${device:json}) or ${device:json}[0] == "$__all")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "address"])

panels.title: Switching state of the actuators
panels.description: The decoded 'state' field of relays and the switching commands sent to them.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and (r._field == "state" or r._field == "switching_command"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.device_name, set: ${device:json}) or ${device:json}[0] == "$__all")
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "_field"])

panels.title: Silent devices (last telegram per address)
panels.description: A device which has not reported for a long time either has an empty battery, a wrong address or a wrong EEP configured.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["address", "device_name", "eep"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "address", "device_name", "eep"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "last seen"})

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["area", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["area"])

panels.title: Repeater level (rp_count) per address
panels.description: How often a telegram was repeated before it arrived. A high value means the device is far away or the path is weak.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r._field == "rp_count")
  |> group(columns: ["address", "device_name"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> keep(columns: ["address", "device_name", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "avg repeater level"})
